holding.line: So what's the use of holding?
stanza: Grandmother
Sleep tight, sleep loose
It's alright, everything that happened, happened
So what's the use of holding?
It's unfolding, we're all insane
We are made of love
We are also made of pain
If you ever need holding
Call my name, and I'll be there
If you ever need holding
And no holding back, I'll see you through
Sky blue and black

holding.line: Oh, I am loving, always holding
stanza: Oh, I am loving, always holding
While she sleeps, her song enfolding
Epic song it tells of how
She and I are living now
There was your breath
On the back of my neck
The only one holding
The only one I had felt in years

unfolding.line: I am folded and unfolded and unfolding
